content.value: Obtaining a meaningful material family for the first time rewards World XP. Ore, raw metal, ingot and nugget variants share their mineral discovery. Crops and seeds share a discovery, as do stripped and ordinary logs of one wood species. Moving, placing, breaking or receiving the same materials again does not repeat the reward.

Discovering every ingredient needed by a supported recipe can reward World XP once for that knowledge family. Alternate recipes, station duplicates, wood variants and colour variants do not multiply the reward. Alchemy formulas reward their first successful discovery; failed and repeated experiments do not.

Each new biome rewards World XP once. Spend a few seconds inside a generated structure to discover that instance, with an additional first-type milestone. First taming, breeding and catching each eligible species are separate personal discoveries.
World Discovery XP Bonus increases personal first-discovery rewards, up to 50% from that stat. Each player makes discoveries individually; repeating an already recorded discovery does not pay again.
Discovery records survive death and reconnecting. Trading an already discovered material or repeatedly opening the same recipe does not create another discovery reward.
